name: Jellymon
main_effect: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with [Jellymon] in its text and 1 [Kiyoshiro Higashimitarai] among them to your hand. Place the remaining cards at the bottom of your deck in any order.
source_effect: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When one of your effects trashes a card in your hand, gain 1 memory.
